_comment: SAMPLE shot list for 'Act I' (~305s). Replace with your own shots.json. Schema per shot: id, scene, start, dur, type, prompt, ref_photo, treatment, vo_text, vo_voice, (optional) caption_es. Shots are assembled in 'start' order; total runtime = max(start+dur).

shots.prompt: A small apartment at first light, dust in the air, two coffee cups on the table, slow push-in, cinematic, warm window light
shots.vo_text: We met in a city that never quite learned our names.

shots.prompt: A hand-drawn map pinned to a wall, pins and red thread connecting places, slow dolly across, soft lamp light
shots.vo_text: She kept a map of everywhere we promised to go.

shots.prompt: Close on hands folding a letter at a kitchen table, morning light, intimate, shallow depth of field
shots.vo_text: Te escribí cada mañana, aunque no lo sabías.
shots.caption_es: Te escribí cada mañana, aunque no lo sabías.

shots.prompt: A person standing by a window holding a phone, expression falling, rain beginning outside, handheld, intimate
shots.vo_text: Then one call took all the color out of the room.

shots.prompt: An empty chair across a table, one cup pushed aside, cold light, slow zoom, melancholic
shots.vo_text: You left the way weather leaves — without apology.

shots.prompt: Rain streaking down a dark window, city lights bokeh behind, slow, moody, reflective
shots.vo_text: Miss misery — that was the song that winter.

shots.prompt: A lone figure walking wet empty streets at night, sodium streetlights, long lens, cinematic
shots.vo_text: I walked until the streets ran out of you.

shots.prompt: Hands spreading old photographs across a bed, dim lamp, nostalgic, shallow focus
shots.vo_text: Memory keeps the receipts you wish it wouldn't.

shots.prompt: A person lying awake, ceiling shadows moving, pre-dawn blue, very still, intimate
shots.vo_text: Some nights are just the long way back to morning.

shots.prompt: A phone screen lighting up on a dark nightstand, a single message glowing, hopeful, close-up
shots.vo_text: And then, softly, a name I knew lit up the dark.

shots.prompt: An empty train platform at golden hour, a train arriving, warm light, anticipation, wide cinematic
shots.vo_text: Vine de vuelta por el mismo camino que me llevó.
shots.caption_es: Vine de vuelta por el mismo camino que me llevó.

shots.prompt: A figure crossing a long bridge toward the camera at dawn, river below, hopeful, slow aerial pull-back
shots.vo_text: Forgiveness is a bridge you build from both ends.

shots.prompt: A close portrait turning toward the light, faint smile beginning, warm, color returning, shallow focus
shots.vo_text: Color came back the moment you looked up.

shots.prompt: Two people meeting and embracing in a doorway, warm light flooding in, emotional, slow, cinematic
shots.vo_text: We held on like two halves remembering they fit.

shots.prompt: Sunrise spilling across the same apartment from the prologue, now bright and alive, warm, gentle push-in
shots.vo_text: The apartment learned the light again.

shots.prompt: The wall map again, new pins and bright thread added, hopeful, close dolly, warm lamp light
shots.vo_text: We redrew the map with the places we'd still go.

shots.prompt: Two silhouettes in a bright doorway looking out together, warm backlight, peaceful, wide
shots.vo_text: Juntos otra vez, mirando hacia lo que viene.
shots.caption_es: Juntos otra vez, mirando hacia lo que viene.

shots.prompt: An open road at sunrise stretching to the horizon, warm, expansive, slow aerial forward, hopeful finale
shots.vo_text: Act one ends where the road begins again.
